hooks: How long until your business runs itself?
When does the manual work finally stop?
How long until you can take a week off without everything breaking?
When do you get to stop being the bottleneck in your own business?
How long until your systems work harder than you do?
talking_points: I was talking to a couple of founders in FieldWork who have already automated their entire client onboarding process using simple tools.
And watching so many good people burn out trying to manually follow up with every lead and welcome every new client, it made me think.
How long until most experts figure out you can build an entire client delivery system, perfectly tailored to your style, just by learning how to connect a few modern tools?
It definitely feels a ways away, and I do not think many people are shown how to think about their business this way yet.
But there are multiple people in my program right now who are taking Fridays off because their automated systems are working, while everyone else is scrambling in their inbox.
You have to realize that AI is not just for writing your social media posts or summarizing notes.
AI is for building the actual infrastructure for your business that allows you to own your time again.
It helps you build the engines that make your job easier, less manual, and more effective.
If building a business like that interests you, you should follow me here because I share how to build these kinds of systems.
items.body_copy: How long until the manual work finally stops? There are a couple of founders in my program who have already built systems to automate their entire client onboarding process. And watching so many people get burned out by the constant pressure of manual follow ups and admin, it made me think. It’s definitely a ways away, and I don't think many people know how to do it yet. But there are founders in FieldWork right now who have their systems running for them, and they are enjoying their free time while everybody else is stuck in their inbox. You have to realize that AI is not for your carousels. AI is for building infrastructure for your business that allows you to own your time again, to make your job easier and less manual. If that interests you, you should definitely follow me here.
